proposals.before: During Guangqi the Tujue chieftain Helian Duo raided Yunzhong; the Martial Emperor sent Yuanxin against him, and Yuanxin was defeated at Juyong Pass.
proposals.after: During Guangqi the Tuyuhun chieftain Helian Duo raided Yunzhong; the Martial Emperor sent Yuanxin against him, and Yuanxin was defeated at Juyong Pass.
proposals.reason: 吐渾 is Tuyuhun, not Tujue (突厥); the idiomatic rendering invents the wrong people-name.

proposals.before: In the Guangqi era the Tujue Helian Duo raided Yunzhong; the Martial Emperor sent Yuanxin to resist him, and Yuanxin's army was defeated at Juyong Pass.
proposals.after: In the Guangqi era the Tuyuhun Helian Duo raided Yunzhong; the Martial Emperor sent Yuanxin to resist him, and Yuanxin's army was defeated at Juyong Pass.
proposals.reason: The literal field likewise renders 吐渾 as Tujue instead of Tuyuhun.

proposals.before: After Zhuangzong pacified Henan, Yuanxin was transferred to commissioner of the Henghai circuit.
proposals.after: After Zhuangzong pacified Henan, Yuanxin was transferred and made military commissioner of the Henghai Army.
proposals.reason: 橫海軍節度使 is the Henghai Army military commission; 'circuit' slightly flattens 軍.

proposals.before: Chengxiu heard abruptly that the eastern armies were advancing, was terrified, and asked Zhongba what to do.
proposals.after: Chengxu heard abruptly that the eastern armies were advancing, was terrified, and asked Zhongba what to do.
proposals.reason: 承休 is spelled Chengxu in the surrounding units of this chapter; Chengxiu is an inconsistent romanization of the same person.

proposals.before: Chengxiu marched with the Dragon Martial division and recruits, nearly ten thousand men, leaving Zhongba in charge of arrangements; the prefectural populace and Qinzhou troops turned out to see them off.
proposals.after: Chengxu marched with the Dragon Martial division and recruits, nearly ten thousand men, leaving Zhongba in charge of arrangements; the prefectural populace and Qinzhou troops turned out to see them off.
proposals.reason: Same inconsistent Chengxiu/Chengxu romanization for 承休.

proposals.before: When the Khitan attacked Chunzhou he shrank from the fight and was executed by Jing Yanguang.
proposals.after: When the Khitan attacked Chanzhou he shrank from the fight and was executed by Jing Yanguang.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou (modern Puyang), not Chunzhou.

proposals.before: Earlier the Jiang prefect Wang Jin had rebelled; the Martial Emperor told Yancong he wanted Jin brought in.
proposals.after: Earlier the Jiang prefect Wang Guan had rebelled; the Martial Emperor told Yancong he wanted Guan brought in.
proposals.reason: 王瓘 is Guan, not Jin; Jin also collides with the place-name 晉 in the next unit.

proposals.before: Soon, on a raid near Fen and Jin, Yancong defected to Jiang; Jin thought he had come over willingly, treated him generously, and made him a cavalry officer.
proposals.after: Soon, on a raid near Fen and Jin, Yancong defected to Jiang; Guan thought he had come over willingly, treated him generously, and made him a cavalry officer.
proposals.reason: The second Jin is 瓘 (Wang Guan), not the place Jin.

proposals.before: When Jin went hunting, Yancong struck off his head in mid-gallop and presented it to the Martial Emperor, who was astonished.
proposals.after: When Guan went hunting, Yancong struck off his head in mid-gallop and presented it to the Martial Emperor, who was astonished.
proposals.reason: 瓘 should be Guan throughout, not Jin.

proposals.before: When Zhuangzong entered Ye, Zhang rose to commander of Chun.
proposals.after: When Zhuangzong entered Ye, Zhang rose to commander of Chan.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Chunzhou.

decisions.reason: The source reads 吐渾, the Tuyuhun ethnonym; Tujue would require 突厥.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 光啟中，吐渾赫連鐸寇雲中

decisions.reason: The literal field has the same incorrect substitution of Tujue for 吐渾, Tuyuhun.
The revision restores the full office conveyed by 橫海軍節度使 and matches the literal field.
承休 is standard pinyin Chengxiu. The surrounding Chengxu spellings are the errors and will be normalized in the opposite direction.
承休 is Chengxiu, so the existing form in this sentence is correct despite inconsistent nearby spellings.
澶州 is Chanzhou; Chunzhou is a mistranscription of the place name.
The personal name 王瓘 is Wang Guan, not Wang Jin.
The subject 瓘 remains Wang Guan; only the earlier 晉 in the sentence is the place Jin.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 汾、晉之郊，彥琮奔絳，瓘以為附己

decisions.reason: The abbreviated 瓘 still names Wang Guan and should not be rendered Jin.
澶州 is Chanzhou, conventionally shortened here to Chan, not Chun.
